data.gender_notes: Morgun is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old Norse 'morgunr', meaning 'morning'. In Norse mythology, Morgun is the personification of the dawn. The name Morgun carries the meaning “Morning” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Morgun usually hope their child will grow to embody morning and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Morgun total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
